description: This Java class 'ExceptionFactory' provides static methods to create various custom exceptions related to 'things' and their features, such as not found or inaccessible exceptions, used within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ExceptionFactory
classes.description: A factory class providing static methods to generate specific DittoRuntimeExceptions related to 'things' and their features.

methods.name: attributesNotFound
methods.description: Creates an AttributesNotAccessibleException for a given ThingId and headers.

methods.name: attributeNotFound
methods.description: Creates an AttributeNotAccessibleException for a specific attribute key.

methods.name: featureNotFound
methods.description: Creates a FeatureNotAccessibleException for a specific feature ID.

methods.name: featuresNotFound
methods.description: Creates a FeaturesNotAccessibleException for a given ThingId.

methods.name: aclInvalid
methods.description: Creates an AclModificationInvalidException, optionally with a message.

methods.name: aclEntryNotFound
methods.description: Creates an AclNotAccessibleException for a given authorization subject.

methods.name: featureDefinitionNotFound
methods.description: Creates a FeatureDefinitionNotAccessibleException for a specific feature ID.

methods.name: featurePropertyNotFound
methods.description: Creates a FeaturePropertyNotAccessibleException for a specific property identified by a JsonPointer.

methods.name: featurePropertiesNotFound
methods.description: Creates a FeaturePropertiesNotAccessibleException for a given feature ID.
